nativeProfitBridge.formula: R=sum(segment revenue); C=sum(segment cost); gross=R−C; operating=gross−businessTaxes−selling−admin−RD−finance+otherIncome+equityMethod+investmentOther−creditLoss−assetLoss+FV+disposal; pretax=operating+nonopIn−nonopOut; taxable=pretax−equityMethod; tax=max(taxable,0)×taxRate+taxAdjustment; totalNet=pretax−tax; parent=totalNet−minority; EPS=parent/shares
nativeProfitBridge.finance: CASBE finance already net of interest income and may contain financing related fees; cash not separately added
nativeProfitBridge.tax: taxRate/adjustment explicit, H1 effective28.17% not assumed all15%; equity-method only excluded, other investment income taxable
nativeProfitBridge.normalization: FV/disposal/nonop gains default0; recurring credit/asset losses, safety costs and R&D retained; capitalized development may require later impairment

scoreReasons.industryCycle: 核医学科建设与国产核素可长期扩容，医保价格、医院资本开支和放射安全许可限制短期需求变现

scoreReasons.financialGovernanceDownside: 回款和库存占款严重、母现金仅3.14亿、基金4亿未批准承诺及债务再融资，集团大半利润归少数；央企控制不保股价
